items.title: Amazon.com (AMZN) Blocks Rival AI Shopping Agent On Its Platform
items.summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) has blocked Meta's Muse AI agent from executing purchases on Amazon's retail platform. The restriction targets Muse's shopping functions that rely on direct access to Amazon's product catalog and checkout systems. Rival retailers remain open to AI agents like Muse, creating a split in how major ecommerce platforms handle third party AI shoppers.
